title: Nuevo Laredo Offers 90% Subsidy for Livestock Infrastructure Packages
excerpt: Nuevo Laredo ranchers can get livestock infrastructure packages — 100 iron posts, 10 rolls of wire and a 300-liter feeder — paying only 10% of the cost, with registration opening Tuesday, Nov. 17.
content:
The municipal government of Nuevo Laredo, led by Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal, announced a program offering a 90% subsidy on livestock infrastructure packages for local producers, according to CML Noticias.

Registration for the “Apoyo a la Infraestructura Ganadera” program opens Tuesday, Nov. 17, through the city’s Rural Development office, according to the report. Producers pay only 10% of the total cost.

Each package includes 100 iron posts, 10 rolls of wire and a feeder with a 300-liter capacity, materials meant to improve ranch facilities, according to the report.

Interested producers must present a copy of their current iron registry, an official INE voter ID and their CURP at the Rural Development offices at Matamoros 309, upper floor, in the Centro sector, Monday through Friday, 9 a.m. to 3 p.m., according to the report.

The program joins other municipal livestock efforts, including “Mineraliza tu Ganado,” which supports mineral and water trough purchases plus animal-health services, and a gas-for-chamusque program benefiting 100 ranching families, according to the report. The city has also put more than 4.3 million pesos into improving the Municipal Slaughterhouse and over 700,000 pesos into a wall in the goat area, according to the report.

Source: CML Noticias, November 16, 2026.
